The banked verdict "nested-XOR depth-3 is UNDEFINED because the depth-3 backprop oracle cannot even FIT TRAIN (intrinsic parity optimization wall; no depth-3 ceiling exists)" is FALSE as stated. res.conclusion: The FA learning rate (--lr-fa) is the LOAD-BEARING knob; the sigma-norm gate is helpful but not make-or-break. The 0.839 result is robust DOWNWARD in lr_fa and to removing sigma-norm, but NOT robust to raising lr_fa. Detail: (1) lr_fa=0.02 gives chained_fa=0.881 — even above the committed 0.839, above BPTT (0.782), far above the wide reservoir (0.689), GO 6/6. (2) Turning sigma-norm OFF is a graceful degradation, not a collapse: 0.839 -> 0.764, still +0.075 over the 0.689 wide reservoir, GO 6/6 (just dips ~0.02 below BPTT). (3) Doubling to lr_fa=0.10 COLLAPSES chained_fa to 0.589 — BELOW the 0.689 wide reservoir and only +0.034 above the 0.555 frozen-reservoir floor, GO drops to 3/6, per-seed highly variable. So the credit-rule result reproduces (and improves) at and below the default FA learning rate, but is knife-edge on the high-lr side: it names a real mechanism dependency on lr_fa <= ~0.05, not an artifact of a single tuned point. The default 0.05 sits on the safe side of that dependency.

synth.crux_core_status:

strengthened: BEATS-RESERVOIR (probe A, CONFIRMED): the frozen-optimal reservoir SATURATES in a ~0.65-0.73 band across W256->W2048 and never crosses chained_fa=0.839; per-doubling gain decelerates to +0.012; best single reservoir seed at any width is 0.760 < 0.839. synth.must_correct_committed_findings:
